जिला कृषि पदाधिकारी, मुजफ्फरपुर ने अपने पत्रांक-503/कृ0मुज0, दिनांक-13.02.2023 द्वारा प्रतिवेदित किया है कि परिवादी श्री भारत भूषण, जिला-मुजफ्फरपुर द्वारा दायर परिवाद अधोहस्ताक्षरी कार्यालय को प्राप्त हुआ है। जिसमें प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधि योजना अन्तर्गत जमीन संबंधित विवरणी में Land Seeding नहीं होने के कारण राशि अवरूद्ध होने की शिकायत की गई है। विदित हो कि विभाग द्वारा जमीन संबंधी विवरणी सुधार हेतु दायित्व अंचलाधिकारी को सौंपा गया है। ऐसी स्थिति में श्री प्रसाद द्वारा उक्त ‘Land Seeding :- No’ का सुधार कराने हेतु संबंधित प्रखंड के अंचलाधिकारी से संपर्क स्थापित कर सुधार कराया जा सकता है।

remarks:
CPGRAM CBODT/E/2023/6171 has been filed by the Shri Ashwini Bhide (on behalf of Mr. Divyesh Rama, (seller of property). 
1.	Complainant has stated that Mr. Sandeep Kewalchand Mehta (buyer) had deducted TDS of Rs.7,91,810/- on purchase of immovable property from Mr. Divyesh Rama. However, only Rs.1,25,000/- was deposited by Mr. Sandeep Kewalchand Mehta and the same amount i.e. Rs.1,25,000/- is being reflected in form 26AS for FY 2014-15
2.	Complainant has further stated that the obligation of the buyer (Mr. Sandeep Kewalchand Mehta) and not he assessee to pay the remaining amount of Rs6,66,810(Rs.7,91,810-1,25,000) and hence the amount of demand is liable to be recovered from the buyer. 
3.	In this regard, it is submitted that buyer i.e. Mr. Sandeep Kewalchand Mehta has duly complied with the provision of Section 194IA of the I T Act which provides “that any person, being a transferee, responsible for paying to a resident transferor any sum by way of consideration for transfer of any immovable property (other than agricultural land), shall, at the time of credit of such sum to the account of the transferor or at the time payment of such sum in cash or by issue of cheque or draft or by any other mode, whichever is earlier, deduct an amount equal to one per cent of such sum as income tax thereon . 
4.	In the instant case, the sales consideration is Rs.1,25,00,000/- and the buyer Mr. Sandeep Kewalchand Mehta has duly deposited 1 per cent of Rs.1,25,00,000/- i.e. Rs.1,25,000/- which is being shown in Form 26AS of seller i.e. Mr. Divyesh Rama. Therefore, buyer has duly complied with the provisions of Section 194IA of the I T Act.
5.	 Further, if buyer Mr. Sandeep Kewalchand Mehta has deducted excess TDS then it is payment settlement dispute between buyer and seller which can be resolved by them only. 
6. In view of the above facts and circumstances, there is no violation of TDS provisions, the grievance may kindly be treated as settled.

બંન્ને પતિ પત્નીએ બંન્ને પક્ષોના પંચો/સાક્ષી રૂબરૂ વકીલ પાસે નોટરી કરી રાજીખુશી કાયદેસરના છુટ છેટા કર્યા બાદ અરજદાર ફરીથી પ્રેમીલાબેનને પત્ની તરીકે સ્વીકારવા માગે છે, પરંતુ પ્રેમીલાબેન અરજદાર સાથે પત્ની તરીકે રહેવા માંગતી નથી. આથી અરજદાર અનેક ગણી એકજ વિષયવાળી અરજીઓ PMO PG પોર્ટલના વેબ સાઇડ ઉપર કરતો હોવાનું તપાસ દરમ્યાન જણાય આવેલ છે. અરજદારને થયેલ છુટાછેડા બાબતે મનદુઃખ હોય તો યોગ્ય કોર્ટ રાહે દદ લેવા ત.ક.અમલદારે અવાર નવાર સમજ કરવા છતાં અરજદારે કોર્ટ રાહે કાર્યવાહી કરેલ નથી.
આ કામના અરજદારશ્રી દિપકભાઇ મણીલાલ ગામીત રહે, આમલગુડી તા.સોનગઢ જિ.તાપીનાઓને ઉપરોક્ત બાબતે અત્રેથી પ્રત્યુત્તરો પાઠવેલ છે.

How to update -exit date- in EPFO records
An EPF account holder can update the exit date in EPFO records online via the Member e-Sewa portal.
This is how you can use this facility.
Step 1: Log-in to the Member e-Sewa portal by entering your Universal Account Number (UAN), password, and captcha code. Remember, your UAN must be activated on the portal for you to log-in.
Step 2: Click on the MANAGE tab and select the MARK EXIT option
Step 3: A new tab will open on your screen. Select the employer and EPF account for whom you wish to update the exit date. The date of exit can only be marked two months after the last contribution made by the employer. While entering the date of exit, you can enter any date of the month in which the last contribution was made. You can check for this in your EPFO passbook records.
Step 4: Here, enter the date of exit, and reason for the exit.
Step 5: Click on Request OTP A one-time password (OTP) will be sent to your Aadhaar-linked mobile number. Enter the OTP in the required box.
Step 6: Click on Update and click on Ok.
The exit date will be updated in your EPFO records.

Dear EPF Members / Subscribers

UAN is now compulsory for submitting claims to EPF office.

Do you have PF account prior to January 2014 and want to link to your present UAN or Generate UAN for using Online Services. Here is the small guide

1. Please visit UAN Allotment for Existing PF Account Link available in unifiedportal mem.epfindia.gov. This will work if your old PF account has Name, Father ,Spouse Name, Date of Birth, Gender,Date of joining details. Further your Name, Date of Birth, Gender, BASIC DETAILS should match with your aadhar details. Once these conditions satisfied, you can either generate a new UAN for your old PF account or link your old PF account to your present UAN to avail further online services.

IF the above step is not working for you then

2. You can approach your previous establishment for generating UAN through Employer login. Its available under MEMBER UAN Allottment for Existing Member Menu. This creates a new UAN for that PF account and then member has to do Activation, aadhar, Bank account seeding to avail online services.

3. If both 1 and 2 not working for a member, he can approach his PF office with Form 5 and attested aadhar copy to request it to generate the UAN for the said PF account. Then member has to do Activation, aadhar, Bank account seeding to avail online services.
